title: Rory and the Starry Lagoon
verses:
The sun went to rest and the moon lit the sky,
A gentle breeze blew as the evening went by.
Now Rory walked slow where the blue waters flow,
While soft little stars were beginning to glow.

Up high in the branches flew Nia to rest,
While Psittaco curled in a cozy green nest.
And Ricky ran over to yawn in the shade,
Where silvery shadows were soft in the glade.

Now Benny lay down on the soft mossy ground,
And Tilly curled near without making a sound.
The water shone bright under moonlight so pale,
As Rory sat down with a sweep of his tail.

The fireflies flickered and glowed in the night,
To give all the dinos a sleepy warm light.
Then Psittaco chirped a quick goodnight to all,
As shadows grew soft and the trees stood up tall.

Then Nia tucked quietly under her wing,
While crickets were starting to sleepily sing.
And Ricky was resting right next to a tree,
As cozy and calm as a dino could be.

Now Rory closed gently his two sleepy eyes,
Beneath all the stars in the dark velvet skies.
The valley was resting, so peaceful and deep,
And all of the friends were now soundly asleep.
